description: One hub per tokenised asset OwlChart reads from the contracts: stablecoins (USDT, USDC, USD1, PYUSD, RLUSD...), tokenised treasuries and funds (BUIDL, Ondo...), tokenised gold, governance tokens (WLFI, ONDO) and CARV. Price, supply, value, 24h change, issuer, contract; with the Tokenized Assets pass, Builder, Scale or PRO also the large transfers of the last hour read from the chain, the supply history and the regulation items naming the token. No token given: the list.
